status_note: Milestone 02 adds the world atlas: a real polygon map, a 242-country registry and campaign setup. No simulation, economy, diplomacy or save system runs in this build, and the campaign brief says so before it sends you back to the title screen.
about_paragraphs: WORLD DOMINION is a single-player, offline grand strategy sandbox about leading a nation through a living world. Politics, diplomacy, the economy, the military and international relations are intended to converge into one simulation in which every decision has consequences.

It is being built as one cross-platform game for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux rather than a desktop game adapted later. The simulation is designed to run entirely on the player's device, without accounts and without a backend.
Milestone 02 is the world atlas: the map, the country data behind it and the campaign setup that lets you choose a nation. The simulation itself belongs to the milestones that follow.
